product.schneider-towerat240.summary: The 40 MB Tower AT variant, also documented in Mega configurations.
product.schneider-towerat240.history: System 240 expanded Tower AT storage to 40 MB. Its chronology requires separating model and specimen: Jungsi's overview places early 240s in 1988, whereas Rüdiger Patommel dates his unit to 1990. That specimen has 1 MB and a high-density floppy drive; it does not prove that all 240s shipped with this equipment.
product.schneider-towerat240.technical.c: Preserved configurations are not uniform. MAME describes a 512 KB / 720 KB 2xx base and mentions a 240 Mega; the owner documents 1 MB, 1.44 MB and a 40 MB disk. Both references are retained without merging them into a single specification.
product.schneider-towerat240.technical.f: The located BIOS has a more specific attribution than the name 240. MAME notes 1.07 in a 240 Mega, and both 32 KiB files are preserved. Exact EGA pairing remains unresolved; the pair is not attributed to every 240.
product.schneider-towerat240.warning: Historical sheet under research; booting in BluMach remains unvalidated.
product.schneider-towerat240.technical.v: Sources and file hashes have been checked. BluMach a1b0125d has no dedicated entry for this model; MAME groups Tower AT 2xx machines as not working. Booting has not been tested.
product.schneider-towerat240.technical.l: The complete machine still needs validation. Board, BIOS pair and video ROM must be identified, then POST, memory, keyboard, RTC, disks and ports tested before usable emulation can be claimed.
product.schneider-towerat240.technical.b: A shared case does not guarantee the same board. The preserved manual covers 201/202/220; its architecture guides research, but schematics and revisions for this variant still need comparison.
product.schneider-towerat240.technical.m: Schneider, Service Manual Tower AT 201/202/220, Ident-Nr. 44657, 03/1989: cover and CPU/memory diagrams reviewed; PDF preserved.
product.schneider-towerat240.technical.r: Happy Computer 11/1988, M. Ohnesorg/rz, Rechengiganten zu Niedrigpreisen, pp. 97–98 and 101: review of a Tower AT without a hard disk, with no commercial suffix identified.
product.schneider-towerat240.technical.m: Happy Computer 05/1989, Sammlerstück, p. 18: 220 Mega edition, equipment, prices and announced production run; scan and transcription preserved.
product.schneider-towerat240.technical.o: Rüdiger Patommel, System 240 photograph and description, 23 April 2013: dated to 1990, 10 MHz, 1 MB, 40 MB disk and 1.44 MB floppy. All rights reserved.
product.schneider-towerat240.technical.r: Jungsi, Schneider VGA AT System 40: range overview and approximate chronology; not a substitute for a manual covering each revision.
product.schneider-towerat240.technical.m: MAME, at.cpp: towerat2xx sets, variant provenance and unresolved EGA pairings. Files are preserved in the library; their presence does not prove universal compatibility.
product.schneider-towerat240.technical.c: BluMach a1b0125d, inspected and preserved machine table: no dedicated Tower AT entry.
